mechanics.notes:
• Unlike most classes with a widget, Archivist's widget only appears above the skill when one of the Empowerment skills has been used.
• Each book represents how many Empowerment left to use.
• Most Empowerment skills last for 5 uses of 'Attack' or until the effect expires naturally, whichever occurs first; pop-up headlines when the Empowerment effects expire:
 quote:
• Destroyer's Hunger: Destroyer's hunger is sated.
• Demento's Bane: Demento's bane falls away.
• Ash's Glory: Ash's glory leaves you.
• Wrath of Wargoth: Wargoth's wrath dissipates.
• Xan's Madness: Xan's madness is cleared from your mind.
• Celestia's Sorrow: Celestia's presence fades.
• Kathool's Madness: Kathool's madness fades.
• PvN Fury: Ninja and Pirate fury settles.
• Caitff's Knowledge: Caitiff's Knowledge dissipates.
• Mage's Stalemate: The stalemate is broken.
• Ultimate Orb Creation: The power of the Ultimate Orb is receding.
• Using Paper Scatter skill purges all active Empowerment effects.
• All Empowerment effects from player are immune from buff detection effects.

notes:
• This class cannot use On-Demand weapon specials.
• Original Archivist's timepiece on the male version is attuned to player's equipped weapon's element.
  • Wood elemental attunement for Original Archivist became accessible upon the release of  Spare Chair on  January 28th, 2023.
• Archivist originally started with 6 class skills and gained 3 new skills as the  10th Anniversary quest chain progressed, amounting to 9 skills; after the conclusion of the 10th Anniversary quest chain, this class was updated again with 3 additional skills, amounting to 12 skills.

• A Soulthread is gathered upon using 'Soul Assault' and 'Untangle'. (Pop-up: Soulthread gathered! / Soulthreads at maximum capacity.)

name: DeathKnight
location: The Necropolis -> Artix -> Other Classes! -> Death Knight -> To The Tomb! -> Malifact's Ghost -> Become A Death Knight! -> Wear Death Knight Armor
effect: Picks one of the following effects, depending on the player's Presence (see below), before granting an extra turn to the player;

attacks.name: Necrotic Shift
attacks.description:
Target: (Auto) +<x> Health, <40-80>% DoT for 4 turns. | Self: +<3-6>% HoT for 5 turns.
 Grants another turn after use. Necrotic Shift is lost when Presence is changed.
attacks.requirements: 7th Undead Slayer Badge given to Malifact's Ghost to unlock
attacks.effect:
Picks one of the following effects, depending on the player's Presence (see below), before granting an extra turn to the player;

  • If the player is in Consuming Presence, skill automatically applies 'Necrotic Curse' (a 40% Magic Curse DoT effect, +[X / Y] Health Resist) to target for 5 turns inclusive. (Pop-up: You impose the necrotic curse on your foe!)

    • X is equal to the player's missing HP% while Y is equal to the target's missing HP%.

    • If the player has at least one Utility Relic (see below) equipped, 'Necrotic Curse' will gain an additional +5% damage for each DeathKnight relic equipped.

    • If the player has two Utility Relics equipped, 'Necrotic Curse' will gain an additional 10% damage.

    • With a full set of DeathKnight Relics equipped, 'Necrotic Curse' will cap at a total of 80% damage.

  • If the player is in Healing Presence, this skill will immediately heals them for 2% of their maximum HP and applies 'Necrotic Curse', a HoT effect that heals equal to 3% of player's max HP, for 4 turns. (Pop-up: You force the necrotic curse to sustain you!)

    • If the player has at least one Utility Relic (see below) equipped, 'Necrotic Curse' will heal them for an additional +0.5% of their maximum HP for each DeathKnight relic equipped.

    • If the player has two Utility Relics equipped, 'Necrotic Curse' will heal them for an additional +1% of their maximum HP.

    • With a full set of DeathKnight Relics equipped, 'Necrotic Curse' will heal the player for up to 4% of their maximum HP and becomes a HoT effect that heals equal to 6% of player's max HP for 4 turns.

  • If the player shifts between Consuming Presence and Healing Presence, any 'Necrotic Curse' effects on the player or the target will be removed upon the player's next attack. (Pop-ups: Your necrotic curse recedes as your presence shifts to Consuming. / Your necrotic curse recedes as your presence shifts to Healing.)

mechanics.notes:
• Clicking the widget will toggle between Consuming Presence and Healing Presence.
• While the player is in Consuming Presence:
  • Each of this class's skills besides Necrotic Shift will consume 5% of the player's maximum HP, as will potions and trinket skills. (Pop-up: Shifted to Consuming Presence: Attacks will consume <x> HP for <50-100>% base damage, +<0-50> Bonus, and +<0-50> Crit.)
  • Each of this class's skills will gain an additional +50% total base damage.
  • If the player has at least one Offensive Relic equipped, each of this class's attacks will gain an additional +5% total base damage, +5 Bonus, and +5 Crit for every DeathKnight Relic the player has equipped.
  • If the player has two Offensive Relics equipped, each of this class's attacks will gain an additional +20% total base damage, +20 Bonus, and +20 Crit in addition to all of the above effects.
  • With a full set of DeathKnight Relics equipped, Consuming Presence will cap at a total of +100% base damage, +50 Bonus, and +50 Crit.
• While the player is in Healing Presence, each of this class's skills (besides Necrotic Shift), as well as potions, trinkets, and On-Demand weapon specials, will immediately heal the player for 2% of their maximum HP upon use. (Pop-up: Shifted to Healing Presence. Attacks will heal <x> HP.)
  • For each Defensive Relic equipped, heals an additional +1% HP, capping at 4% heal.

notes:
• If the player has at least one Defensive Relic equipped, the player permanently applies 'Relic Barrier' (+A All Resist, -A Health Resist, -A Light Resist, -A Darkness Resist) to themselves.
  • A is equal to the formula [(Level/16)*(number of Relics equipped)], capped at 5 per Relic while the player is Level 80 or higher.
  • If the player has two Defensive Relics equipped, 'Relic Barrier' will grant an additional +10 All Resist, -10 Health Resist, -10 Light Resist, and -10 Darkness Resist.
  • With a full set of DeathKnight Relics equipped, 'Relic Barrier' will cap at +40 All Resist, -40 Health Resist, -40 Light Resist, and -40 Darkness Resist if the player is Level 80 or higher.
  • 'Relic Barrier' will update its value upon player's attack.
    • If no Defensive Relics are equipped, 'Relic Barrier' is purged upon player's attack.

attacks.name: Corruption
attacks.description:
3 hits x 43.3% damage (130%)
 Target: (Auto) Sets Darkness res to -100 for 99 turns. | Target: (On hit) -25 Boost, -150 Avd for 5 turns. | Target: (On hit) -50 weapon element res for 5 turns. | Target: (On hit) -30 Bonus, -200 Defense for 5 turns. | Target: (On hit) -40 Boost for 6 turns. | Target: (On hit) 100% Curse DoT for 5 turns. | Target: (On hit) -30 Bonus and -30 weapon element res for 5 turns.
 Targeting Corrupted foes empowers certain skills.
attacks.effect:
3 hits of ~43.33% scaled damage, amounting to 130% scaled damage; applies one of the following effects based on the target's race;

  • If target's race is 'Undead': Removes any Darkness Resist from target, then automatically applies 'Corruption' (-100 Darkness Resist) to target for 99 turns inclusive. (Pop-up: Hahaha! An Undead can't stand against me!)

  • If target's race is 'Dragon' or 'Reptilian': Applies 'Corruption' (-150 Melee/Pierce/Magic Avoidance, -25% Boost) to target for 5 turns inclusive. (Pop-up: Those scales won't protect you from me!)

  • If target's race is 'Dwarf', 'Elf', 'Goblinkind', 'Giantkind', 'Gnome', 'Human', or 'Moglin': Applies 'Corruption' (-50 Resist to weapon's element) to target for 5 turns inclusive. (Pop-up: Hahaha! I'll tear you to shreds, mortal!)

  • If target's race is 'Ateala', 'Celestial', 'Elemental', 'Fairy', or 'Infernal': Applies 'Corruption' (-200 Block/Parry/Dodge Defense, -30 Bonus) to target for 5 turns. (Pop-up: You think being not of this world will make me falter?")

  • If target's race is 'Avian', 'Beast', 'Bug', 'Fungus', or 'Plant': Applies 'Corruption' (-40% Boost) to target for 5 turns. (Pop-up: A beast like you can't hope to defeat me!)

  • If target's race is 'Clockwork', 'Food', or 'Golem': Applies 'Corruption', a 100% Magic Curse DoT effect, to target for 5 turns. (Pop-up: Something that has no life cannot defeat me!)

  • If target's race is anything else: Applies 'Corruption' (-30 Bonus, -30 Resist to weapon's element) to target for 5 turns. (Pop-up: No matter what you are, you will fall before me!)

  • X is equal to the target's current Immobility Resist (inclusive of All Resist), floored at 25 and capped at 50; Drained Will' will remove up to 50 Immobility Resist from target and apply the equivalent Resist to player.

  • If target is affected by 'Corruption', 'Drained Will' will instead remove up to 100 Immobility Resist (inclusive of All Resist) from target (bounded below 0) and apply the equivalent Resist to player. (Pop-up: You easily break your foes' will!)

notes:
• The base damage of this class's skills is scaled to the player's Level, using the formula 1+(2*Level/100). Scaling is floored at 100% damage and will reach 280% damage at the maximum level of 90.
• Scaled Mana Cost is equal to [0.2*(Level+5)+1]. Each Mana cost is rounded up to the nearest whole number.
  • Mana Costs will update on player's Level up; this feature was added on  December 12th, 2025.
• Equipping the  Gnarly Guitar of Doom scythe modified the appearance of this class by changing its shoulder plates; with the release of Rocker  Armor Customization on  November 27th, 2020, this functionality was removed.
• Void Barrier's damage reflection was adjusted from a static 40% to its current diminishing value on  January 11th, 2020.
• The following changes were implemented on  April 19th, 2024:
  • 'Attack', 'Lingering Doom', 'Corruption', 'Drain Will', 'Drain Essence', 'Blood Rite', and 'Necrotic Strike' skills received various changes.
  • Tooltips were updated to be dynamic.
• 'Malefic Grasp' was reworked on  June 20th, 2025.

• If the player's trained STR and INT are both at least [Level+10] (100 at Level 90) and their total STR and INT, including points from gear, are within 20 points of each other, each of this class's skills will gain +50% base damage.
• The following effects are Counter effects and will apply 'Counterattack' to player:
  • 'Instinctual Counter'.
  • 'Prepared Counter'.
  • 'Bracing Counter'.
  • 'Slayer's Counter'.
  • While it has a Counter effect active, the first time each turn an attacker's hit lands or glances the player, the player automatically apply 'Counterattack' (+100% Boost, +200 Crit) to themselves for 1 turn, which is signified with  this animation and the helmet's glow from widget; Instinct stacks cannot be gained if a Counter effect is active.
• While DragonSlayer is equipped, the player applies the following permanent effects to themselves:
  • 'Slayer's Instinct' (+2Z% Non-Crit/Crit Damage Reduction): Z is equal to the player's current Instinct stacks (capped at 5); Instinct stacks are gained from receiving direct damage (once per turn).
  • 'Slayer's Analysis' (+10A Crit): A is equal to the player's current Analysis stacks (capped at 5); Analysis stacks are gained from triggering 'Counterattack' effects; Analysis stacks can be used to activate 'Phantasm of Akriloth' and 'Dragonslayer' skills.

notes:
• The base damage of this class's skills is scaled to the player's Level, using the formula [4.2858*(Level+5)+14.284]/100, capped at level 40. Scaling is floored at 100% damage and will reach a maximum of 207% damage at level 40 or higher.
• Scaled Mana Cost is equal to [0.3008*(Level+10)+1.0025]. Each Mana cost is rounded up to the nearest whole number, capped at level 40; this was implemented on  November 24th, 2023.

mechanics.notes:
• Evolved PumpkinLord has a Candy counter that starts at 0 and caps at 5.
  • This has no relation to Candy gained from Mogloweens.
• 1 Candy is gained each time a hit from Evolved PumpkinLord (including trinkets and On-Demand specials) lands.
  • Candy collection from trinkets and On-Demand specials is capped at 2 per use.
• At 5 Candy, Evolved PumpkinLord can spend all of its Candy to empower its skills, giving them increased/stronger effects, but will not gain Candy.
• Clicking the widget above the Attack button allows the player to check the amount of Candy they have, or toggle Candy empowerment if they have 5 Candy. [Pop-ups: Not enough candy! (<0-4>/5 Candy collected) / Next skill empowered with Candy. / No longer empowered with Candy.]
• The amount of Candy is represented by the widget's appearance:  0 /  1 /  2 /  3 /  4 /  5.

• The Ninja class was originally released on  October 12th, 2007 before being revamped on February 6th, 2015; it was revamped again to its current version on  April 21st, 2023.

mechanics.notes:
• Clicking the shield displays the current amount of 'Inner Light' (see other information) stacks. (Pop-up: Inner Light at <1-20>)
  • The arcs in the widget light up for every 5 stacks of Inner Light, adding a sigil on top at 20 stacks.
• Clicking the left hand will allow the player to toggle  Smite. [Pop-up: You harness your Inner Light to smite your foe! (+100 base damage, -400 Crit on attack) / You recollect the Light from your smite.]
  • The player must have at least 5 'Inner Light' stacks to toggle Smite.
  • While Smite is toggled, 5 'Inner Light' stacks is consumed each turn as all class skills gain +100% base damage and -400 Crit.
    • If both Smite and Unlock are toggled, instead consumes 6 'Inner Light' stacks.
• Clicking the right hand will allow the player to toggle  Unlock. [Pop-ups: You hold back your Inner Light to unlock your Light-element skills. (Suppresses +1 Inner Light from Light skills) / You restore your Inner Light, allowing it to grow again.]
  • While Unlock is toggled, consumes 1 Inner Light stack each turn to remove the Light-element lock on certain skills.
    • No Inner Light stack is consumed if the skill used does not have a Light-element lock.
    • Skills that have their Light-element locks removed still will gain an additional stack of Inner Light.
    • Array of Light-element lock skills: 'Prismatic Strike', 'Dawn's Light', 'Crushing Light', 'Aura of Light', 'Seal of Courage', 'Seal of Celerity', 'Channeling Spirit'.

• 1 stack of Plunder is gained at the start of the next turn whenever the player uses an Opening; 3 stacks are gained upon using 'Cursed Treasure'.

mechanics.notes:
• Widget displaying weapon element appearance:  Weapon Element
• Clicking the Pyromancer's Tome widget will toggle each of this class's skills between Fire damage and weapon element damage. (Pop-up: The flames burn with your weapon's element, but attacks do 10% less damage overall. / The flames burn bright with fire!)
  • Orange color signifies Fire damage while the blue color signifies weapon element damage.

• While 5 stacks of 'Pyromancer's Flames' are active (indicated by the widget), each class skill will gain +100% total damage.

images.caption: Pyromancer's widget displaying Magefire and Pyromancer's Flames.

notes:
• If either DEX or INT is the player's highest attacking stat, each of this class's skills will gain +5% total damage.
  • If both DEX and INT are the player's highest attacking stats and within [Level/10] of each other, including points from gear, each of this class's skills will instead gain +25% total damage.
• Pyromancer begins every battle with 'Healing Magefire' permanently applied.
• While 'Healing Magefire' is active, the player will automatically recover 1% of their maximum HP every turn for each active stack of 'Pyromancer's Flames,' capping at 5% per turn.
• While 'Consuming Magefire' is active, each of this class's skills gains +20 Crit for each active stack of 'Pyromancer's Flames,' capping at +100 Crit.
• While 'Devouring Magefire' is active, the player will automatically recover 10% of their maximum HP every turn and each of this class's skills will gain +150% total damage and +200 Crit. 'Devouring Magefire' will also disable the effects of 'Healing Magefire' and 'Consuming Magefire'.
• Class must be equipped to enter  Yonathan's Barber Shop.
• The Pyromancer class was originally released on  November 9th, 2012 and revamped on  August 7th, 2020.
• The following changes were implemented on  September 15th, 2023:
  • Bonus damage when DEX/INT are both higher and within [Player's Level/10] of each other was increased.
  • Penalty for using weapon element damage from the widget was increased.
  • 'To Ashes', 'Pyromancer's Flames', 'Breath of Fire', and 'Conflagration' skills were modified.
• The following changes were implemented on  May 17th, 2024:
  • Tooltips were updated to be dynamic.
  • 'Magma Bubble' and 'Triflame!' skills were modified.
• 'Healing Magefire' and 'Consuming Magefire' became permanent effects on  October 11th, 2024.

 Self: Blade Enhancement: +<120/180> Crit for 4 turns. | Self: Gun Enhancement: Resist death, +<x> STR/DEX/INT for 3 turns. (When hit) -<x> STR/DEX/INT, -<20/30> Bonus, <x>% Silver DoT to foe for 7 turns. | Self: Tool Enhancement: Purge and heal <10/15>% max HP/MP. | Self: Tricky Prey: +15 Boost, +25 Bonus, +25 Crit, +20 Avd for 7 turns.
 Effect and cooldown changes based on combo type.
attacks.requirements: Level 10; 7th Bloody Monster Heart given to Symone to unlock; player's current total combo step must be equal to 3.
attacks.effect:
Applies an effect based on the highest combo type (see below); 2 hit of 75% damage, amounting to 150% damage.

  • Sword Combo: Applies 'Blade Enhancement' (+60X Crit) to player for 4 turns inclusive, where X is equal to the current Sword Combo step; 'Prey Seeker' will have a cooldown of 11 turns after use.

  • Gun Combo: Applies 'Shining Barrier' (+[(Level/2) * Y] STR/DEX/INT, player cannot go below 1 HP by any direct damage) to player for 3 turns inclusive; while affected by 'Shining Barrier', if the player received direct damage, automatically applies 'Argyrosis' (a 25Y% Magic Silver DoT effect, -[(Level/2) * Y] STR/DEX/INT, -10Y Bonus) to target for 8 turns inclusive; 'Prey Seeker' will have a cooldown of 11 turns after use; Y is equal to the current Gun Combo step.

  • Tool Combo: Purges all status effects (excluding 'Stuffed', permanent effects, and effects applied by the player and their allies) from player and recovers [5Z]% of player's max HP and MP, where Z is equal to the current Tool Combo step; 'Prey Seeker' will have a cooldown of 8 turns after use. (Pop-up: You cleanse your debuff effects and heal!)

  • Balanced Combo: Applies 'Tricky Prey' (+15% Boost, +25 Bonus, +25 Crit, +20 Melee/Pierce/Magic Avoidance) to player for 7 turns inclusive; 'Prey Seeker' will have a cooldown of 11 turns after use.
attacks.cooldown: Varies based on the highest combo type
attacks.notes:
• Balanced Combo is used if there is no majority of the player's combo step.

notes:
• ShadowHunter has 3 Combo skills that affect other class skills: 'Sword Combo', 'Gun Combo', and 'Tool Combo'; each of those skills increments its corresponding combo step by 1, and increases the effects of other skills
  • Most skills affected this way count the total combo step across all 3 combos.
  • If the player's current combo step is equal to 3�gained from using a total of 3 'Combo' skills�regardless of which are used, all 'Combo' skills are disabled.
  • Upon using any of the combo skills, if 'Hunter Combo' is not already active, ShadowHunter applies 'Hunter Combo' to player for 5 turns inclusive, refreshing its duration if it is already active. 'Hunter Combo' gains +Boost, +Bonus/Crit, and +Melee/Pierce/Magic Avoidance from using 'Sword Combo', 'Gun Combo', and 'Tool Combo' skills respectively.
    • The effects of 'Hunter Combo' depend on the combos that have been used, as well as their current combo step:
      • 'Sword Combo': +25%/40%/50% Boost, depending on Sword combo step.
      • 'Gun Combo': +40/65/80 Bonus/Crit, depending on Gun combo step.
      • 'Tool Combo': +30/50/60 Melee/Pierce/Magic Avoidance, depending on Tool combo step.
    • A pop-up warning appears when 'Hunter Combo' is about to expire. (Pop-up: Your Hunter Combo is about to fade.)
    • When 'Hunter Combo' expires or is purged, all combo steps are reset to 0 and all 'Combo' skills will have a 3 turn cooldown.
• A is equal to the current total combo step, capped at 3.
• Fully train this class to unlock  Shadow Hunter badge.
• ShadowHunter was originally released on  November 4th, 2013 and received the following changes on  November 29th, 2024:
  • Class's name was changed from 'Shadow Hunter' to 'ShadowHunter'.
  • ShadowHunter received a visual update and a mechanical rework.
• 'Sword Combo', 'Gun Combo', 'Tool Combo', 'Finisher', 'Prey Seeker', 'Shadowbane', 'Revenantbane', and 'Evilsbane' received various changes on  February 14th, 2025.
• The duration of 'Focused Hunt' was reduced from 5 turns to 4 on  June 20th, 2025.

mechanics.notes:
• The player's Heat, Drive Boost, and current WIS stat will be announced at the beginning of the battle. After the first announcement, the player must click the widget for their Heat, Drive Boost, and current WIS stat. (Pop-up: Heat Level: <0-20>, Drive Boost: <0-200>, Drive Core Calibration: <x> WIS.)
  • One stack of Heat is gained each turn, starting from 0 and capping at 20. At the end of every turn, the player will lose an amount of MP equal to their number of Heat stacks before calculating Drive Boost and usable skills. (Pop-up: Danger: Heat levels at maximum.)
    • Heat is represented at the bottom right side of the widget as well as the bar at the center of the widget.
  • Drive Boost will raise the base damage of each of its skills by 2% for every 1% of MP missing, reaching a maximum of 200% extra base damage per skill at 0% MP remaining.
    • Drive Boost is represented at the bottom left side of the widget as well as the bar at the top of the widget.
  • If the player's WIS changes by more than Level/5 compared to its declared value (either upwards or downwards) during a battle, Drive Boost will become disabled, triggering Recalibration. [Pop-up: WIS deviation of |(<x> - <y>)| detected. Drive Core Mismatch Error: Drive Boost recalibrating to <y> WIS.
    • <x> is equal to player's current WIS while <y> is equal to player's previous WIS.
    • While affected by Recalibration, Drive Boost will display  'ERR' on the bottom left on the widget.
  • Recalibration has a minimum duration of 2 turns inclusive, but is extended for every [Level / 10] WIS deviated. [Pop-up: Heat Level: <0-20> Drive Boost: Recalibrating to <x> WIS for <y> turn(s).]
  • If Recalibration is triggered again while already Recalibrating, additional turns are added to its duration.
